review:
Lucky Crew is a 20-line pirate slot where the Jolly Roger's crossed bones represent wild multipliers. Wilds appear only on reels 2, 3 and 4 and randomly get a 2x or 3x multiplier, which applies to every line they're part of.

Three or more compass scatters trigger free spins, and before the round starts, the captain turns the ship's wheel to decide how many spins you get. A bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 3,525x maximum and a 95.98% RTP. It shares its structure with Penny Pelican.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
